title: add_codeowner
description: Appends a new entry to the CODEOWNERS file, associating a file path pattern with one or more owner handles.

pattern.description: The file path glob pattern for which ownership is being defined, following CODEOWNERS syntax (e.g. '*.go', 'src/auth/', 'docs/**').

owners.description: A list of one or more GitHub user handles or team slugs to assign as owners for the pattern (e.g. ['@alice', '@org/backend-team']).

items.description: A GitHub user handle (e.g. '@alice') or team slug (e.g. '@org/platform-team') to assign as a codeowner.
